candidates.citation: NBWC CR 25-16 — Lyon County — Mason Valley WMA: Eastside Waterfowl Series Ponds
candidates.summary: Eastside Waterfowl Series Ponds are open to fishing August 16 through September 30 only (all other times of year closed, as part of the Mason Valley WMA closed-waters default).

candidates.citation: NBWC CR 25-16 — Lyon County — Mason Valley WMA: Eastside Waterfowl Series Ponds

parameters.counting_rule: Daily limit is 5 trout plus 15 warmwater game fish, of which not more than 2 may be black bass. Possession limit is 10 trout plus 30 warmwater game fish, of which not more than 4 may be black bass. Trout and warmwater game fish are separate sub-limits, not interchangeable.

candidates.summary: Daily limit is 5 trout and 15 warmwater game fish (no more than 2 black bass); possession limit is 10 trout and 30 warmwater game fish (no more than 4 black bass).

candidates.citation: NBWC CR 25-16 — Lyon County — Mason Valley WMA: Eastside Waterfowl Series Ponds

parameters.note: Applies only to black bass counted within the warmwater game fish daily/possession sub-limit.

candidates.summary: Black bass kept must be at least 14 inches total length.

candidates.citation: NBWC CR 25-16 — Lyon County — Mason Valley WMA: Eastside Waterfowl Series Ponds
candidates.summary: Fishing is allowed any hour of the day or night during the open season.

parameters.note: Standard Nevada resident/nonresident fishing license required for anglers 12 and older.

candidates.summary: A Nevada fishing license is required for anglers age 12 and older; no license required under age 12.
